I confirmed Pree's correction in a thread reply in #central-team: the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Gate 47, which replaces the Dock 23 she posted this morning.

Nothing else was needed. I hadn't saved the earlier Dock 23 fact anywhere, so there's no stored copy to fix. Her correction is now in the #central-team history next to the original message, so anyone looking will see both.
